notes.notes:
Changes:

    Updated training.
    Fixed some "Impassable" levels.
    Minor fixes on levels.
    Some graphical adjustments.

notes.title: Regotown 2.0 is coming soon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457913/57fa856547027f7d7536c7796af53ea39ea48719.png[/img]
Finally, I'm ready to announce that update 2.0 is coming soon (working title "Echoing Steps of Angels")

Changes:

Gameplay -

    Changes in some weapon timings
    Changes in enemy attack timings
    Greater variety in enemy behavior
    Changes in the behavior of all creatures.

Graphics:

    General improvement in graphics quality
    More diverse background animations
    Listing changes could go on forever

IMPORTANT:

    Changes in the storyline
    Story inserts
    Over ten new levels
    Many old levels improved or almost completely changed
    Many new creatures
    Changes in player behavior
    More interesting situations and traps
    More interaction

With version 2.0, the amount of content will increase exponentially!!!

From the developer, without formality: Thank you all who bought Regotown. Sorry for the long wait for updates, I understood what and where could be improved or changed, but it's not that simple. Some changes always bring bugs and inconsistencies in other events. I didn't want to change something in certain aspects, but break others. I decided to make version 2.0 with fixes for everything at once. Also, I can say that the game version 1.0 was not made quickly, and now, over 2.0, I'm working at the limit of my abilities. Thank you for your patience. You can play 1.0 now to be even more surprised by 2.0, as it can be considered a different game. The quality of everything will be increased exponentially))))
